blind.description: No readable text or labels are present on the renders or model. The model consists of a tall rectangular stone column/pier with a molded base plinth and flat molded capital, connecting to a curved stone arch or buttress arm that descends to a smaller molded base on the ground. Sculpted organic relief vines and a diagonal support brace run along the arch. Surfaces are solid and continuous with clean geometry; there are no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and no surfaces are melted or glitched. It stands independently on its own two molded plinth bases which sit flat on the floor, with no added display slab, plinth disc, or terrain base. Materials are weathered greenish-grey stone with mossy accents, green/brown vines, and a red-patterned top surface on the column cap. There are no black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), it appears as a narrow linear strip or bracket extending between a rectangular red-patterned block at one end (the top of the column) and a small stepped foot at the other, with its curved arch shape clearly outlined in the shadow cast onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 1.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 9 to 9.5 ft tall) and about 1.8 to 1.9 times as wide as the figure is tall (approximately 10.5 to 11 ft wide across the span).
